text.p: Dillon Read said it upgraded PacifiCare Health Systems Inc to buy from outperform.

-- On Thursday, PacifiCare Health Systems Inc reported a sharp drop in second quarter operating profits, resulting from rising drug costs and problems integrating the newly acquired FHP International Co.
-- Dillon Read said earnings were consistent with PacifiCare's earlier guidance.
-- the company saw "relatively strong" net Medicare enrollment increases.
-- said efforts toward profitability in Utah, Nevada, oregon, Texas and California are progressing.
-- said set a price target of $95 a share. The time frame for the target was not immediately available.
